[Thinking] **Proposing project structure** I need to propose a full project that involves asking follow-up questions. I'll outline a likely tech stack, focusing on Python, FastAPI, and a frontend. The goal is to create a functional app that searches bug bounty programs based on criteria. Data sources could include public APIs like HackerOne or Bugcrowd, but they may require keys. I might suggest starting with a static dataset or scraping before using curated JSON for import. I'll craft a response detailing the MVP featuring FastAPI, SQLite, and code snippets, while also including questions about preferred languages and data sources. [/Thinking] Below is a complete **MVP project scaffold** for a “Bug Bounty Program Finder” that: - Stores bug bounty programs in a local database (SQLite) - Lets you **search/filter/sort** by criteria (min bounty, platform, vuln types, reputation score, etc.) - Provides a simple **web UI** + a JSON API - Includes a place to **import/sync data** from external sources later (HackerOne/Bugcrowd/etc.) I’m going to make a few default choices to get you a working app quickly: - **Language**: Python - **Backend**: FastAPI - **DB**: SQLite (via SQLAlchemy) - **Frontend**: Server-rendered HTML (Jinja2) + minimal JS (easy to run) - **Data ingest**: Start with a `seed.json` file; later add connectors to APIs If you want Node/React instead, say so and I’ll re-scaffold. --- ## 1) Project file structure ``` bug-bounty-finder/ ├─ README.md ├─ pyproject.toml ├─ .env.example ├─ .gitignore ├─ data/ │ └─ seed_programs.json ├─ app/ │ ├─ main.py │ ├─ settings.py │ ├─ db.py │ ├─ models.py │ ├─ schemas.py │ ├─ crud.py │ ├─ seed.py │ ├─ search.py │ ├─ routers/ │ │ ├─ api.py │ │ └─ web.py │ ├─ templates/ │ │ ├─ base.html │ │ ├─ index.html │ │ └─ program.html │ └─ static/ │ └─ styles.css └─ tests/ └─ test_search.py ``` --- ## 2) Dependencies / libraries ### `pyproject.toml` ```toml [project] name = "bug-bounty-finder" version = "0.1.0" description = "Search and filter bug bounty programs by criteria" requires-python = ">=3.11" dependencies = [ "fastapi>=0.110", "uvicorn>=0.27", "sqlalchemy>=2.0", "pydantic>=2.0", "pydantic-settings>=2.0", "jinja2>=3.1", "python-multipart>=0.0.9", ] [project.optional-dependencies] dev = [ "pytest>=8.0", "httpx>=0.27", "ruff>=0.4", ] [tool.pytest.ini_options] pythonpath = ["."] ``` --- ## 3) App code (copy/paste) ### `app/settings.py` ```python from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings class Settings(BaseSettings): # SQLite by default for a zero-config MVP. # Later you can swap to Postgres: postgresql+psycopg://... database_url: str = "sqlite:///./bugbounty.db" class Config: env_file = ".env" settings = Settings() ``` ### `app/db.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import create_engine from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, DeclarativeBase from .settings import settings # SQLite needs this for multi-threaded ASGI use. connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False} if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite") else {} engine = create_engine(settings.database_url, connect_args=connect_args) SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False) class Base(DeclarativeBase): pass def get_db(): """ FastAPI dependency that yields a DB session and ensures it closes. """ db = SessionLocal() try: yield db finally: db.close() ``` ### `app/models.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import String, Integer, Float, Text from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column from .db import Base class Program(Base): """ Represents a bug bounty program. Notes on fields: - reputation_score is an internal score you can compute later (from reviews/metrics). - vuln_types is stored as a comma-separated string for MVP simplicity. Later: normalize into a separate table or JSON column (Postgres). """ __tablename__ = "programs" id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), index=True) platform: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), index=True) # e.g., hackerone, bugcrowd, independent url: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(500)) description: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, default="") # Bounty amounts (USD) as a rough normalized baseline. min_bounty: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, default=0) max_bounty: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, default=0) # Example: "xss,sqli,rce,ssrf" vuln_types: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(500), default="") # Ease of participation: 1..5 (subjective for now) ease: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=3) # Reputation: 0..100 (subjective/derived later) reputation_score: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=50) ``` ### `app/schemas.py` ```python from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import Optional, List class ProgramOut(BaseModel): id: int name: str platform: str url: str description: str min_bounty: float max_bounty: float vuln_types: str ease: int reputation_score: int class Config: from_attributes = True class SearchQuery(BaseModel): """ Selection criteria: - text: keyword search across name/description - min_bounty: only programs with max_bounty >= min_bounty (or min_bounty >= min_bounty) - platform: filter - vuln: require vuln type keyword to appear in vuln_types - min_reputation: filter by reputation_score - min_ease: filter by ease """ text: Optional[str] = None min_bounty: Optional[float] = Field(default=None, ge=0) platform: Optional[str] = None vuln: Optional[str] = None min_reputation: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100) min_ease: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=5) sort: str = "reputation" # reputation | max_bounty | name order: str = "desc" # asc | desc limit: int = Field(default=50, ge=1, le=200) ``` ### `app/crud.py` ```python from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from sqlalchemy import select from .models import Program def get_program(db: Session, program_id: int) -> Program | None: return db.get(Program, program_id) def list_programs(db: Session, limit: int = 50) -> list[Program]: stmt = select(Program).limit(limit) return list(db.execute(stmt).scalars().all()) def create_program(db: Session, program: Program) -> Program: db.add(program) db.commit() db.refresh(program) return program ``` ### `app/search.py` ```python from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from sqlalchemy import select, or_ from .models import Program from .schemas import SearchQuery def search_programs(db: Session, q: SearchQuery) -> list[Program]: """ Implements selection criteria (filtering + sorting). Improvement ideas: - Replace naive LIKE searching with full-text search (SQLite FTS5 or Postgres tsvector). - Store vuln_types as a normalized table to avoid substring false positives. """ stmt = select(Program) if q.text: like = f"%{q.text.strip()}%" stmt = stmt.where(or_(Program.name.ilike(like), Program.description.ilike(like))) if q.platform: stmt = stmt.where(Program.platform == q.platform) if q.min_bounty is not None: # Accept either min_bounty or max_bounty meeting the threshold. stmt = stmt.where((Program.max_bounty >= q.min_bounty) | (Program.min_bounty >= q.min_bounty)) if q.vuln: # Simple contains match; later do normalization. stmt = stmt.where(Program.vuln_types.ilike(f"%{q.vuln.strip()}%")) if q.min_reputation is not None: stmt = stmt.where(Program.reputation_score >= q.min_reputation) if q.min_ease is not None: stmt = stmt.where(Program.ease >= q.min_ease) # Sorting sort_map = { "reputation": Program.reputation_score, "max_bounty": Program.max_bounty, "name": Program.name, } sort_col = sort_map.get(q.sort, Program.reputation_score) if q.order.lower() == "asc": stmt = stmt.order_by(sort_col.asc()) else: stmt = stmt.order_by(sort_col.desc()) stmt = stmt.limit(q.limit) return list(db.execute(stmt).scalars().all()) ``` ### `app/seed.py` ```python import json from pathlib import Path from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from .models import Program def seed_from_json(db: Session, path: str = "data/seed_programs.json") -> int: """ Loads initial data into the DB if empty. This makes the app usable immediately without external APIs. """ p = Path(path) if not p.exists(): return 0 existing = db.query(Program).count() if existing > 0: return 0 data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) created = 0 for item in data: prog = Program( name=item["name"], platform=item.get("platform", "independent"), url=item["url"], description=item.get("description", ""), min_bounty=float(item.get("min_bounty", 0)), max_bounty=float(item.get("max_bounty", 0)), vuln_types=item.get("vuln_types", ""), ease=int(item.get("ease", 3)), reputation_score=int(item.get("reputation_score", 50)), ) db.add(prog) created += 1 db.commit() return created ``` ### `app/routers/api.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from ..db import get_db from ..schemas import ProgramOut, SearchQuery from ..crud import get_program from ..search import search_programs router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["api"]) @router.get("/programs/search", response_model=list[ProgramOut]) def api_search( text: str | None = None, min_bounty: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=0), platform: str | None = None, vuln: str | None = None, min_reputation: int | None = Query(default=None, ge=0, le=100), min_ease: int | None = Query(default=None, ge=1, le=5), sort: str = "reputation", order: str = "desc", limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200), db: Session = Depends(get_db), ): q = SearchQuery( text=text, min_bounty=min_bounty, platform=platform, vuln=vuln, min_reputation=min_reputation, min_ease=min_ease, sort=sort, order=order, limit=limit, ) return search_programs(db, q) @router.get("/programs/{program_id}", response_model=ProgramOut) def api_get_program(program_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): prog = get_program(db, program_id) if not prog: # keeping it simple; you can raise HTTPException(404) later return None return prog ``` ### `app/routers/web.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from ..db import get_db from ..schemas import SearchQuery from ..search import search_programs from ..crud import get_program router = APIRouter(tags=["web"]) templates = Jinja2Templates(directory="app/templates") @router.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse) def home( request: Request, text: str | None = None, min_bounty: float | None = None, platform: str | None = None, vuln: str | None = None, min_reputation: int | None = None, min_ease: int | None = None, sort: str = "reputation", order: str = "desc", db: Session = Depends(get_db), ): q = SearchQuery( text=text, min_bounty=min_bounty, platform=platform, vuln=vuln, min_reputation=min_reputation, min_ease=min_ease, sort=sort, order=order, limit=50, ) results = search_programs(db, q) return templates.TemplateResponse( "index.html", {"request": request, "results": results, "q": q}, ) @router.get("/program/{program_id}", response_class=HTMLResponse) def program_page(request: Request, program_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): prog = get_program(db, program_id) return templates.TemplateResponse("program.html", {"request": request, "p": prog}) ``` ### `app/main.py` ```python from fastapi import FastAPI from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from .db import Base, engine, SessionLocal from .seed import seed_from_json from .routers import api, web app = FastAPI(title="Bug Bounty Finder") # Create tables (MVP approach; later use Alembic migrations) Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) # Seed DB on startup (only if empty) with SessionLocal() as db: seed_from_json(db) app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="app/static"), name="static") app.include_router(web.router) app.include_router(api.router) ``` --- ## 4) Templates + CSS ### `app/templates/base.html` ```html {{ title if title else "Bug Bounty Finder" }}

Bug Bounty Finder

Search bug bounty programs by compensation, vuln type, reputation, and ease.

{% block content %}{% endblock %}
``` ### `app/templates/index.html` ```html {% extends "base.html" %} {% block content %}

Results ({{ results|length }})

{% for p in results %}
{{ p.name }}
Platform: {{ p.platform }} · Bounty: ${{ "%.0f"|format(p.min_bounty) }} - ${{ "%.0f"|format(p.max_bounty) }} · Rep: {{ p.reputation_score }} · Ease: {{ p.ease }}
Vulns: {{ p.vuln_types }}
Open
{% endfor %}
{% endblock %} ``` ### `app/templates/program.html` ```html {% extends "base.html" %} {% block content %}
{% if not p %}

Not found

{% else %}

{{ p.name }}

Platform: {{ p.platform }}

{{ p.description }}

Bounty: ${{ "%.0f"|format(p.min_bounty) }} - ${{ "%.0f"|format(p.max_bounty) }}

Vuln types: {{ p.vuln_types }}

Reputation: {{ p.reputation_score }} / 100

Ease: {{ p.ease }} / 5

View Program

{% endif %}
{% endblock %} ``` ### `app/static/styles.css` ```css body { font-family: system-ui, Arial, sans-serif; background: #0b0f17; color: #e8eefc; margin: 0; } a { color: #9ecbff; text-decoration: none; } .container { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; } .header { margin-bottom: 16px; } .card { background: #121a2a; border: 1px solid #23304a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin: 12px 0; } .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; } label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; } input, select { padding: 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #2a3a5c; background: #0b1222; color: #e8eefc; } button, .button { padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #2a3a5c; background: #18284a; color: #e8eefc; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .muted { color: #a9b7d5; font-size: 13px; } .list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #23304a; border-radius: 10px; } .title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; } .tags { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: #c7d6f5; } @media
